Cap.10: Dimensional
Homeostasis & Cysts
Dimension Immune
System (1/2)
• 3 Stages
(`HomeostasisStage`):
`STABLE` (<40),
`IRRITATED` (>=40) &
`IMMUNE_RESPONSE`
(>=70; cytokine >=85).
Blasts, Pylon spam &
Matriarch P2 (+20)
raise chunk

`homeostasisSensitizati
on` (0–3).

Dimension Immune
System (2/2)
• Acid Rain &
`antibody_cyst`: under
open sky during
`IMMUNE_RESPONSE`,
acid rain deals `2.0`
dmg. Cysts grow (cap
`64`/chunk); covering
>=4 faces
(`SMOTHER_FACE_THRE
SHOLD`) smothers
Pylons until
harvested/sedated.

Cap.10: Hive Cycle
Protocol & Mutators
Hive Cycle Protocol &
Mutators (1/4)
• Post-Matriarch
Activation: After
defeating
`apex_matriarch`,
interact with
`matriarch_altar`
without a valid
offering to open
`CycleProtocolScreen`,
pick 1–3 of 6

mutators, and launch
Cycle N (clears
remission).

Hive Cycle Protocol &
Mutators (2/4)
• Mutators I–III:
`hyper_adaptation`
(+45% learning, x0.85
thresholds, +35% pts),
`perpetual_tide` (+50%
tide duration & lower
end threshold, +40%
pts), and
`acute_homeostasis`
(+40% immune stress,
+35% pts).

Hive Cycle Protocol &
Mutators (3/4)
• Mutators IV–VI:
`synaptic_swarm`
(+wave/expedition
attackers & elite rate,
+40% pts),
`primordial_apex`
(+25% boss HP/+15%
DMG & faster
cooldowns, +50% pts),
and `hyphal_overload`
(+35% hyphal
pressure, +30% pts).

Hive Cycle Protocol &
Mutators (4/4)
• Completion &
Records: Defeating
`apex_matriarch`
during an active Cycle
scores `1000 * mult +
speed(<=500) -
deaths*120` (min
`250`), awarding rank
S+..C, high scores, and
the `overmind_cycle`
engram.

Spoiler-Free Hints

(1/3)

Lab T2): test

• Secret 2 (Lab):

Antidote, Biomass &
Amethyst Shard.
• Secret 3 (Act II /

Core.

(2/3)

Primordial specimen.

near outcrops or
fertilize
Bioluminescent Caps.

Cap.11: Engram I:
Outbreak Signal
Engram I: Outbreak
Signal (1/2)
• Field Log: Every
`field_engram` stores
its key inside
`engram_id` and is
absorbed into the
Codex on right-click
with zero inventory
clutter.

Engram I: Outbreak
Signal (2/2)
• Tactical Note (Act
I): Sealed outbreak
vaults preserve early
bio-records before
the Hive adapts to
your primary damage
channels.

Cap.11: Engram II:
Synaptic Bloom
Engram II: Synaptic
Bloom
• Field Log: Relay
nodes amplify nearby
combat telemetry by
`1.5x` and link up to
`28` blocks across
neighboring mycelium.
• Tactical Note (Act
I): Placing a
`purification_pylon`

between linked nodes
severs their synaptic
arc and dampens
cascade alerts
before excavation.

Chitin Resonance
Engram III: Chitin
Resonance (1/2)
• Field Log:
Recovered from a
fallen `hive_core`. Its
chitinous resonance
attunes `ELITE` armor
plates and bench
`synaptic_core`
upgrades.

Engram III: Chitin
Resonance (2/2)
• Tactical Note (Act
II): Upgrade the
workbench to Lab T2
with `synaptic_core` to
unlock experimental
formulas and reduce
biomass consumption.

Cap.11: Engram IV: Tide
Pressure
Engram IV: Tide
Pressure
• Field Log: Harvested
upon slaying
`spore_behemoth`. Its
carapace splits into
`ARMORED_CARAPACE`
armor and exposed
`WEAK_POINT` anatomy.
• Tactical Note (Acto
III): Shatter the

carapace to trigger
`STAGGERED`: its weak
point lowers
physically and takes
`1.35x` follow-up
damage.

Cap.11: Engram V: Mimic
Deception
Engram V: Mimic
Deception
• Field Log:
`synaptic_mimic`
organisms mirror your
dominant attack
profile and shift
stances to punish
repetitive damage
spam.
• Tactical Note (Acto
III): Alternate fire,

magic, or
`purifier_grenade`, or
fire
`false_engram_injecto
r` to bait their
adaptation before
engaging.

Hyphal Memory

Memory (1/2)

player paths

Engram VI: Hyphal

nodes with
`synaptic_graft` or

`neural_echo_decoy`

sieges.

Cap.11: Engram VII:
Homeostasis Trauma
Engram VII:
Homeostasis Trauma
• Field Log: Inside
`deep_mycelium`, blasts
and pylon density
push chunk stress to
`IMMUNE_RESPONSE`,
triggering acid rain
and sensitization `0–3`.
• Tactical Note (Acto
III): When

`antibody_cyst` seals
>=4 faces of a pylon
it smothers protection
until cleared; sedating
restores stability.
